name: auth.jwks
description: Returns a public JSON Web Key Set for the supplied [public-key] arguments, removing duplicates, allowing other systems to verify RS256 tokens created by [auth.ticket.create]

public-key.description: RSA public key as PEM, or DER as base64 or byte[], to include in the key set, repeat for multiple keys

output.description: Returns a [keys] node with one child per supplied key, having [kty], [use], [alg], [kid], [n] and [e]
